title: escalate coercion until anonymous counterevidence
context: Year 1 V5 actor goals and plans viewed through source-scoped temporal knowledge; normative evolution not automatic.
observed_actions: Subordinates class-score optimization to forcing Suzune's submission, deploys private-point and injury allegations, defends against her audio recording with complete video, then halts immediate pressure on receiving older anonymous audio.
observed_result: Suzune begins to kneel; the anonymous evidence disrupts the interaction, and Ryūen says the extortion/humiliation goals were not achieved while he turns to investigating an unidentified counterparty.
epistemic_limits: The anonymous sender is not identified; 500000 was promised according to Ryūen but payment is not verified; the tape's Ibuki/Kinoshita inconsistency must remain explicit.
information_available: Private intent, public action and later retrospective statements stay in separate temporal lanes.
counterfactual_test: Under alternate incentives, trust and history, goal reprioritization is contingent, never pre-scripted.
